tool_config.name: confirm_action
tool_config.description: Confirm a prepared action after she clearly says yes, only when the prepare tool said she can confirm by voice. Never send a PIN. If the result says pin_required_on_screen, tell her to type her PIN on the screen. The money is then sending; the screen shows the tick.
